errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: The screen hit an unexpected error. Your saved data is safe. Reloading usually fixes it.
errorBoundary.safe: Bills, items and parties not yet sent are safe on this device.

sync.offlineHint: No connection. You can browse and print; saving needs the internet for now.
sync.updateHint: A new version is ready. Reload to use it.

dlg.title: Bills that need attention
dlg.intro: The server did not accept these bills. Nothing is lost: each is still on this device. Fix the problem and send it again, or discard it.
dlg.renumber: Give a new number and send
dlg.renumberHint: The paper copy already given out shows the old number. Reprint it after this.
dlg.discardConfirm: Discard this bill? Its stock and credit are given back. This cannot be undone.
dlg.useExisting: It is the same one: use the existing
dlg.useExistingHint: Waiting bills will use the one already on the server. Stock typed in for the new one is not added to it.
dlg.rename: It is different: change the code or name
dlg.discardRecordConfirm: Discard this? It is removed from this device and never sent.

sync.stale: {{count}} bill(s) have been waiting to sync since {{time}}. Download a backup so they cannot be lost.
sync.clock: This device's clock is {{minutes}} minutes {{dir}} the server. Bill dates come from this clock; please correct it.

toast.offline: You are offline. Keep billing: everything is saved on this device and sent when the connection returns.
toast.refused_one: The server did not accept {{count}} item. Open "needs attention" at the top.
toast.refused_other: The server did not accept {{count}} items. Open "needs attention" at the top.
toast.serverTrouble: The server is having trouble. Your work is safe on this device and will be sent again shortly.

done.renumber: Given a new number and sending now. Reprint the paper copy.
done.useExisting: Now using the one already on the server.
done.rename: Saved with the new code or name. Sending now.

device.title: Not yet sent
device.body: Bills, items and parties made while offline are kept on this device until the server has them. A backup file keeps them safe even if this browser's data is cleared.
device.waiting_one: {{count}} entry (bill, item or party) is waiting to be sent.
device.waiting_other: {{count}} entries (bills, items or parties) are waiting to be sent.
device.protectOn: On: the browser will not clear this data when space is low.
device.protectOff: Off: the browser may clear this data when space is low. Installing the app usually fixes this.
device.downloaded_one: Backup saved: {{count}} entry (a .json file to restore from and a .csv spreadsheet).
device.downloaded_other: Backup saved: {{count}} entries (a .json file to restore from and a .csv spreadsheet).
device.nothingToBackUp: Nothing is waiting, so there is nothing to back up.
